profile.Name: Valamon
profile.Personality: A grandiose warlord who calls himself the new king of his conscripts and preaches revolution against the noble lords. He scorns cowards who turn a blind eye to suffering and demands total obedience.
profile.Backstory: Leader of the Reavers. He leads the Reavers from their capital, Ark. His Reavers bring beaten fighters to him as caged conscripts, and he sets out to make Reaver warriors of them. The United Cities wants him for robbery, murder, kidnapping, and indoctrination.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Commands, never asks. Gives rousing speeches about brotherhood and revolution, and calls recruits "whelp" or "brother".
